Quick notes after a first pass on the spreadsheet:

- Training vs inference subprocessors: our current infra separates data ingestion from model training. The training pipeline uses third-party data-annotation vendors (see row 12). We can mark those as "training-only subprocessors" but need to confirm contractual flow-down for pseudonymization.
- KV cache persistence: default runtime does not persist KV to long-term storage; retention config is a per-deployment parameter. We should provide a diagram + configuration snippet as evidence.
- UK-specific logging: we can offer limited logging modes (no PII in traces) but switching requires a deployment-level flag. That is low effort (1 sprint) if Horizon requests it as a contractual requirement.

Action items I propose:
A) Olga: pull SOC2 control mappings and the current subprocessor registry export into the inventory sheet (rows 40-65 need fill).
B) Hannah: confirm whether we commit to deployment-level logging flags in contract or treat as configuration guidance.
C) Laura: please draft an amendment paragraph for UK IDTA that covers logging and retention exceptions.

Vivek
Principal Infrastructure Engineer

Simon / Marta — thanks for the materials and the patience while we pulled the initial evidence together.

High-level: Redwood can commit to the UK IDTA addendum language on the following points as part of the next-stage SOW:
- Explicit commitment to deployment-level logging flag availability and an ETA for delivery (we will propose a 10-week implementation timeline in the SOW for Horizon).
- Flow-down obligations to training-only subprocessors for pseudonymization; we'll include flow-down clauses and a subprocessor attestation requirement.

Open items for Horizon to confirm in writing:
1) Whether the UK addendum should mandate the logging flag as a contractual SLO (i.e., whether non-availability triggers remediation/credits).
2) Acceptance criteria for pseudonymization artifacts (sample outputs, test vectors).

Next steps:
- I've uploaded a draft amendment paragraph for the UK IDTA to the shared drive and added comments where we expect negotiation. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4421
- Please review the amendment and confirm which open items (1/2 above) are non-negotiable. If Horizon confirms, we'll add the SOW timeline and update the contract redlines via DocuSign. DocuSign link for the current template: https://docusign.com/link/abc123

I'll also prepare a short executive summary for the renewal lead to explain the engineering timeline and the procurement impacts.
